Faculty Vacancies
Tuesday, 25 August 2015
6154 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society invites applications for the following posts-
1. Professor in TB and Chest
2. Associate Professor in Radiodaignosis, Surgery and Dental
3. Assistant Professor in Medicine, General Surgery, Anesthesia, Pediatrics, Skin VD, Radiodiagnosis, Psychiatry
4. Senior Residents in Medicine, General Surgery, Anesthesia, Radiodiagnosis, TB and Chest.
The applicant should send their application to the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram. Dist. Wardha (MS) by
20th September 2015
. The applicants are also invited for a walk-in interview along with the applications and supporting documents at 10 am on any working day. The appointments would be adhoc till the Selection Committee of MUHS meets.
Qualification: As per the Medical Council of India norms
Pay Scale : As per 6th pay commission
For senior residents: Consolidated salary of Rs 42140/- per month
For more details call at 07152 – 284341 to 284355 (Ext. 203)  or email at
khssgm@rediffmail.com
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
